objective: Validate a source-unit-correct, positivity-preserving panel transport whose emitted integer pseudobulk is exactly PDS-invisible on every non-panel coordinate.

production_semantics.baseline_profile: gate staged a15 log1p effects at control CPM strictly greater than 10 and b_ctrl strictly greater than zero; compute clip(expm1(b_ctrl + gated_effect), 0, inf) / 50000; normalize over all 18533 genes
production_semantics.baseline_integer_totals: floor(400 * L * q0_g) independently for every gene, matching production quasi emission
production_semantics.actual_library_replay: use one numpy default_rng(0) across contexts A,B,C and targets in canonical order; choose 400 control rows without replacement per target; L is int(min(median(chosen library sizes), 1000000))

dose_policy: All four doses are invariant diagnostics only. No result from this experiment may select, rank, tune, or promote a dose.

continuous_transform.eligible: control CPM strictly greater than 10, b_ctrl strictly greater than zero, baseline abundance strictly positive, finite residual, and response gene is not the row's target-self
continuous_transform.preclip_negative: record every eligible coordinate whose value before clipping is strictly negative
continuous_transform.degenerate_fallback: if all transformed mutable weights sum to zero, copy the baseline mutable integer totals and record the fallback

integer_budget_transport.immutable_coordinates: copy baseline emitted pseudobulk totals exactly for every non-panel gene, target-self, and ineligible panel gene
integer_budget_transport.mutable_budget: sum of baseline emitted pseudobulk totals over eligible off-diagonal panel coordinates
integer_budget_transport.allocation: take floor of every ideal allocation, then assign one count to the largest fractional remainders until the exact mutable budget is exhausted
integer_budget_transport.integration_requirement: a future production implementation must pass these integer totals directly into the exact-total quasi scatter; converting them back to a floating profile and reflooring is not authorized

required_invariants: candidate integer totals are finite nonnegative int64
every non-panel integer total is bit-identical to baseline
target-self integer total is bit-identical to baseline
every ineligible panel integer total is bit-identical to baseline
mutable panel integer budget is exactly conserved
full panel integer total is exactly conserved
grand emitted integer total is exactly conserved
scorer-normalized non-panel linear profile is bit-identical
scorer-normalized non-panel log1p profile is bit-identical
scorer-normalized non-panel effect against the same control is bit-identical
scorer-normalized target-self linear and log1p values are bit-identical

decision.mechanical_pass: Every required invariant must pass on every context, target, dose, and library scheme.
decision.promotion: Always false. This mechanics audit cannot authorize production integration, count generation, held evaluation, or submission. A separately frozen biological confirmation must validate the exact integer-transported candidate.
